title: Create: Paper to flight
description: Adds a crafting recipe for an elytra using the create mod to deploy paper onto a netherite ingot.
body: A data pack that adds an elytra crafting recipe with a piece of paper and a netherite ingot. This must be used with the create mod sense; you need a deployer, similar to a datapack made by "Shalz" in his one block series, but updated to 1.21.1.
